title: Rally deployment diagram
description: How Rally runs: one Cloudflare Worker with static assets and a D1 database. The browser runs the whole game; the Worker only issues seeds, replays submissions and serves the files.

nodes.name: Player's browser
nodes.description: Runs the game itself; one player per device.

nodes.name: Cloudflare edge
nodes.description: Runs the Worker on games.icelander.net/retro/rally*, ahead of the games hub's custom domain.

nodes.name: rally Worker
nodes.description: worker/index.ts: the high-score API and scores page; every other path is a static asset from ./dist.

nodes.name: Games hub
nodes.description: The games hub at games.icelander.net (the recreations repository's Worker): sign-in, /me, the multiplayer lobby and one WebSocket relay per online match.
nodes.condition: Online matches (opened with ?match=ID), and the default name for a signed-in player

artifacts.name: game.js
artifacts.description: esbuild bundle of src/main.ts, minified; served as a static asset and run in the browser.

artifacts.name: index.html and styles
artifacts.description: The page, its CSS and _headers (a strict Content-Security-Policy), copied into dist/.

artifacts.name: Worker script
artifacts.description: The fetch handler, bundled by wrangler with the engine it replays.

relationships.description: HTTPS: the page, its assets and the API under api/.
WebSocket /multiplayer/match/{id} for online matches; GET /me for the default name.
